answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the crystal accrues. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its nectar from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the pulse behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal 1qosc.
